comment: The Praetorium's BNpcBase 14560: what it did in five retail runs (Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.10) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (2026-11-17, visits 0.14 and 0.16), 50e72631 (2026-11-17, visit 0.5) and 6320ae56 (2026-11-18, visit 0.3), all with Duty Support; `questkit sources --duty 16`: its rotation's pace and each action's median amounts). actions.comment: 7 uses; 2.7 s cast; hit 2 at once.
